scope: Five display-only family illustrations. Image generation and image QA do not establish webpage art acceptance or user approval.
direction_reference_usage: Inspected for varying family size, hierarchy and harmonious family-card composition; not passed as a generation input.
count_policy: Counts are this illustration's art direction only, not permanent product limits or gallery additions.
image_processing: Selected tool output PNGs copied byte-for-byte; original alpha preserved. No procedural image editing, compositing, resizing or postprocessing.
validation_limitations: Image-level review only. Browser layout, mobile appearance and final user art approval remain with root task.
Very low-alpha stray generated pixels can extend strict nonzero bounding boxes toward edges; visible (alpha >=16) bounding boxes are recorded separately.
No alpha cleanup applied, to preserve tool output and comply with no Python image editing.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent family illustration for Dot Icon Studio website.
Create a fresh FIVE-member Dots family scene based on Image 1's identity, colors and beautiful short-plush texture. Recompose freely; do not simply preserve the three-member arrangement.
Exactly five round plush companions: (1) one large cornflower-blue sphere wearing proper black headphones with lilac ear cushions, the main anchor slightly left of center; (2) smaller rose-pink sphere with transparent pink round glasses nestled front-right; (3) smaller lilac sphere with a soft pale-yellow bucket hat peeking behind-right; (4) a tiny mint sphere nestled low-left against the big blue sphere; (5) a tiny pale peach sphere tucked near the lilac sphere at upper-right.
Every sphere has just TWO simple black oval eyes, fully visible and naturally directed toward a nearby friend. NO mouths, noses, brows, hands, arms, legs or feet anywhere. Headphone cups contact sphere sides, continuous headband follows sphere contour. Glasses sit naturally against pink sphere, no floating bridge. Hat fits lilac sphere while revealing both eyes.
Art direction: tender energetic little huddle, big blue sphere about twice diameter of tiniest sphere; one dominant anchor plus companions of three genuinely varied sizes. Asymmetric diagonal rhythm, plausible soft contact and partial overlap, all five identities visible. Show 5 separately readable plush bodies, never duplicate one character. Not a lineup or equal-sized grid. Composition wider than tall about 1.25:1 with complete shapes, 8% clear side/top margins and 13% clear space below on canvas.
Rendering: exquisite dense fine short fibers that follow spherical curvature, soft pastel colors, subtle plush compression at contact, soft upper-left studio light unified across all five, gentle surface self-shading. Black eyes with tiny restrained catchlights, no glassy wet plastic bodies.
True transparent RGBA PNG. No floor, ground plane, scene, detached cast shadow, background plate, text, logo, UI or watermark. One composed cutout group for a family card.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent family card illustration for Dot Icon Studio.
Create a NEW scene of the three original chibi humans from reference Image 1, with natural close friendship and gaze interaction instead of standing in a row posing for a photo. Preserve their distinctive identities and reference's lovely detailed 3D craftsmanship: chestnut-haired boy with teal knitted cardigan and cream shorts; warm-brown-haired girl with a loose high bun, sunny-yellow hoodie and cream shorts; light blond young person with clear round glasses, pale-blue collared shirt and cream cardigan.
Composition and action: the brown-haired girl is the central slightly larger figure, sitting casually with one knee tucked, carefully holding a small yellow folded-paper star in her lap with BOTH hands. Teal-cardigan boy sits close at her left, leaning his head inward and looking warmly down at the paper star, his own hands rest naturally on his knees. Blond glasses friend crouches slightly behind at right, leaning toward the girl and looking fondly at the star; one visible hand rests gently on girl's shoulder, the other rests on their own knee. Real coherent eye lines toward shared object, varied gentle smiles, three different head tilts; eye whites and iris directions correct. Show all three complete bodies and footwear, compact front/back depth and distinct heights. Keep all faces readable and unoccluded. A candid shared moment of delight, not a front-facing class photo.
Hands: small but anatomically credible hands, no fused fingers, no extra arms, fingers separated naturally and only where necessary. Star held only by girl's two hands; no ambiguous shared or merged hand anatomy.
Materials: soft skin, delicately modeled layered hair locks with fine directional strands, finely stitched knitted cardigans and hoodie fabric, tiny seams and collar thickness, cream sneakers. Soft unified upper-left studio light; restrained glossy catchlights only in eyes. Original characters only, do not recreate any anime character or copied costume.
Framing: compact asymmetric group aspect about 1.2:1, complete unclipped silhouettes within transparent canvas, 9% clear top/sides and 13% clear space below. No equal-size lineup, no grid, no portraits-only crop.
True transparent RGBA PNG. No ground plane, floor, detached cast shadows, background, text, UI, logos or watermark.
